x-dockyard.format: Community server card using SEP-1649 field names at the path that proposal published. Not part of the MCP specification. The proposed JSON Schema URL (https://static.modelcontextprotocol.io/schemas/mcp-server-card/v1.json) returns 404, so this document does not set $schema. SEP-2127 moved the extension to an AI catalog and GET {mcp-url}/server-card.
